svg.title: STR-400 Retaining & Boundary Walls
svg.text: S T R E E T
GARDEN -0.50 TO VILLA +0.00 — 0.50 m OF RETAINED GROUND
External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Layout only. No member size, no slab or footing depth, no
reinforcement and no load appears on this sheet or
anywhere in the STR series. Those are the structural
engineer's, and a column schedule with sizes invented by
an architect is worse than none, because somebody builds
2. The grid, the column coordinates, the spans and the slab
edges are measured from the same geometry the architecture
is drawn from and are exact.
3. The parapet is 250 mm and the client has specified it:
brick, rendered both faces. That names what it is made of
and nothing more. Since P32 it is also the guard to every
terrace and to the penthouse roof, standing 1.10 m, which
is a structural duty rather than a material one: whether
250 mm of brick carries a guard load cantilevering off a
slab, and whether it has to be reinforced or become
4. The garden sits 0.50 m below the villa, so the change in
level is retained somewhere along the west face and around
the forecourt. Where is drawn; how is not.
5. The street wall's height is the client's choice and
indicative at 1.20 m; its line awaits the measured survey.
Nothing else on this sheet depends on either.
6. Retaining design, drainage behind the wall, movement
joints and foundations are the engineer's and wait on
EZBIT ABU RUKBAH, QUESNA, MENOUFIA, EGYPT
Layout for the engineer's design — no member sizes, no reinforcement, no loads. Not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P30 2026-10-12 site corrected to Ezbit Abu Rukbah; Code 305 named as the fire code
P31 2026-10-12 ground parameters recorded on GEO-002; water table given as 2.50 m
P32 2026-10-13 roof access: ladder to +16.45, guard at 1.10, top now +17.55
P33 2026-10-13 parapet specified brick; the penthouse guard enters the bill
